WITH per_transref AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
grand_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_transref
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount,
         p.avg_anlycount - g.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM per_transref AS p
  CROSS JOIN grand_avg AS g
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > g.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS above_avg_mean
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT a.transref, a.avg_anlycount, a.difference,
       a.avg_anlycount - s.above_avg_mean AS excess_over_above_avg_mean
FROM above_avg AS a
CROSS JOIN step4 AS s
ORDER BY excess_over_above_avg_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
